// @vitest-environment node
import pg from "pg";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { assertDisposableProofUrl } from "../scripts/run-required-db-proofs.mjs";
import { stageSensitiveDemoSeed } from "./fixtures/retired-pre-bot/scripts/sensitive-demo-seed.mjs";
import { sensitiveKeyring } from "../api/_lib/sensitiveDataCrypto.js";
import { revealRow } from "../api/_lib/sensitiveContent.js";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

const runLive = process.env.RUN_DEMO_CASEWORK_DB_TESTS === "1";
const tables = [
  "casework_access_grants", "casework_strength_analyses", "casework_bargaining_workspaces",
  "casework_bargaining_proposals", "casework_bargaining_events", "casework_deadlines",
  "casework_deadline_extensions", "casework_checklist_templates", "casework_checklists",
  "casework_checklist_items", "casework_step_transitions", "casework_alerts",
  "casework_alert_acknowledgements", "casework_management_people", "casework_management_entries",
  "casework_management_addenda", "casework_retaliation_reports", "casework_retaliation_patterns",
  "casework_retaliation_pattern_reports", "casework_retaliation_pattern_notes",
  "casework_intake_drafts", "casework_entity_links", "casework_reminders", "casework_audit_events",
];
const logicalKey = {
  casework_retaliation_pattern_reports: "pattern_id::text || ':' || report_id::text",
  casework_audit_events: "case_id::text || ':' || event_type || ':' || metadata::text",
};

describe.skipIf(!runLive)("casework SAMPLE parity live lifecycle", () => {
  let client;
  const runs = {};
  const seedClient = { rpc: async (name, args) => {
    const calls = {
      sensitive_demo_seed_plan: ["select public.sensitive_demo_seed_plan($1,$2) data", [args.p_lane,args.p_run_id]],
      stage_sensitive_write: ["select public.stage_sensitive_write($1,$2,$3,$4) data", [args.p_actor,args.p_operation,args.p_arguments,args.p_envelopes]],
    };
    const [sql, values] = calls[name];
    return { data: (await client.query(sql,values)).rows[0].data, error:null };
  } };

  async function snapshot(lane) {
    const suffix = lane === "presg" ? ":presg:organization" : ":ud:organization";
    const org = (await client.query(
      "select private.member_stress_uuid($1::text || $2::text) id",
      [runs[lane], suffix],
    )).rows[0].id;
    const result = {};
    for (const table of tables) {
      const key = logicalKey[table] || "id::text";
      const { rows } = await client.query(
        `select count(*)::integer count,
          md5(coalesce(string_agg(${key}, E'\\n' order by ${key}), '')) hash
         from public.${table} row where row.organization_id = $1`,
        [org],
      );
      result[table] = rows[0];
    }
    return result;
  }

  async function status(lane) {
    return (await client.query(
      "select private.demo_seed_function_parity_status($1, $2) result",
      [lane, runs[lane]],
    )).rows[0].result;
  }

  beforeAll(async () => {
    if (!process.env.SUPABASE_DB_URL) throw new Error("SUPABASE_DB_URL is required");
    client = new pg.Client({
      connectionString: assertDisposableProofUrl(process.env.SUPABASE_DB_URL),
      ssl: false,
      application_name: "demo-casework-parity-lifecycle-test",
    });
    await client.connect();
    await client.query("begin");
    runs.presg = (await client.query(
      "select id from private.presg_demo_runs where state in ('applied','verified') order by updated_at desc limit 1",
    )).rows[0]?.id;
    runs.uniondemo = (await client.query(
      "select id from private.uniondemo_runs where state in ('applied','verified') order by updated_at desc limit 1",
    )).rows[0]?.id;
    if (!runs.presg || !runs.uniondemo) throw new Error("both disposable SAMPLE lanes must be applied first");
  }, 30_000);

  afterAll(async () => {
    if (!client) return;
    await client.query("rollback");
    await client.end();
  });

  it("seals both SAMPLE lanes after the ENC tail and reproduces both former plaintext writers", async () => {
    const ring = sensitiveKeyring("demo");
    for (const lane of ["presg","uniondemo"]) {
      const plan = (await seedClient.rpc("sensitive_demo_seed_plan",{p_lane:lane,p_run_id:runs[lane]})).data;
      for (const table of ["member_accommodation_requests","casework_retaliation_reports","casework_retaliation_patterns"]) {
        const rows = (await client.query(`select * from public.${table} where organization_id=$1`,[plan[0].organization])).rows;
        expect(rows.length, `${lane}/${table}`).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        for (const row of rows) {
          const fixture = plan.find(item => item.purpose===table && item.record===row.id);
          expect(fixture).toBeDefined();
          const opened = revealRow(table,row,ring);
          for (const [field,value] of Object.entries(fixture.fields)) {
            expect(row[field]).toBe("[encrypted]");
            expect(opened[field]).toBe(value);
            expect(row.encrypted_content[field].keyVersion).toBe(ring.active);
          }
        }
      }
      // Execute the actual pre-ENC writers under the current enforcement trigger.
      // A savepoint rolls back their cleanup and every attempted plaintext write.
      for (const [migration,name] of [["20260829030000_member_support_programs.sql","demo_seed_apply_member_support"],["20260830050000_demo_seed_casework_completion.sql","demo_seed_apply_casework"]]) {
        const source = readFileSync(new URL(`../supabase/migrations/${migration}`,import.meta.url),"utf8");
        const start = source.indexOf(`create function private.${name}(`);
        const end = source.indexOf("$function$;",start)+"$function$;".length;
        await client.query("savepoint former_plaintext_writer");
        await client.query(source.slice(start,end).replace("create function","create or replace function"));
        await expect(client.query(`select private.${name}($1,$2)`,[lane,runs[lane]])).rejects.toMatchObject({code:"22023"});
        await client.query("rollback to savepoint former_plaintext_writer");
      }
    }
  },60_000);

  it("denies client execution of private helpers and an unscoped restriction bypass", async () => {
    await client.query("savepoint denied_helper");
    await client.query("set local role authenticated");
    await expect(client.query(
      "select private.demo_seed_apply_casework('presg', $1)", [runs.presg],
    )).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "42501" });
    await client.query("rollback to savepoint denied_helper");

    const caseId = (await client.query(
      "select private.member_stress_uuid($1::text || ':parity:case:10') id", [runs.presg],
    )).rows[0].id;
    await client.query("savepoint denied_guard");
    await client.query("set local role service_role");
    await client.query("select set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{\"role\":\"service_role\"}', true)");
    await expect(client.query(
      "update public.member_cases set is_restricted = not is_restricted where id = $1", [caseId],
    )).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "42501" });
    await client.query("rollback to savepoint denied_guard");

    const unionCaseId = (await client.query(
      "select private.member_stress_uuid($1::text || ':parity:case:10') id", [runs.uniondemo],
    )).rows[0].id;
    const unionOrg = (await client.query(
      "select private.member_stress_uuid($1::text || ':ud:organization') id", [runs.uniondemo],
    )).rows[0].id;
    await client.query("savepoint forged_scope");
    await client.query("select set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{\"role\":\"service_role\"}', true)");
    await client.query("select set_config('unionground.demo_seed_casework_scope', $1, true)", [JSON.stringify({
      lane: "presg",
      runId: runs.presg,
      organizationId: unionOrg,
    })]);
    await client.query("set local role service_role");
    await expect(client.query(
      "update public.member_cases set is_restricted = not is_restricted where id = $1", [unionCaseId],
    )).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "42501" });
    await client.query("rollback to savepoint forged_scope");
  });

  it("measures complete, chapter-safe, two-page, zero-outbound evidence", async () => {
    for (const lane of ["presg", "uniondemo"]) {
      const result = await status(lane);
      expect(result.ok, JSON.stringify(result.casework)).toBe(true);
      expect(result.catalogEvidenceMatches).toBe(true);
      expect(result.pageDepth.caseworkHistory).toMatchObject({ minimum: 100, pageSize: 50, ok: true });
      expect(result.pageDepth.caseworkHistory.actual).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(120);
      expect(result.casework).toMatchObject({
        outboundDeliveries: 0,
        checklistStateMismatches: 0,
        alertAcknowledgementMismatches: 0,
        bargainingPulseMismatches: 0,
        retaliationPatternChapterMismatches: 0,
      });

      const steward = (await client.query(
        "select private.demo_seed_user($1, $2, 1) id", [lane, runs[lane]],
      )).rows[0].id;
      await client.query("savepoint authenticated_pages");
      // The tenant policy requires enrolled MFA for every staff read. Add a
      // transaction-only factor so this assertion exercises the real
      // authenticated steward RLS path instead of a database-owner shortcut.
      await client.query(
        `insert into auth.mfa_factors
           (id, user_id, friendly_name, factor_type, status, created_at, updated_at)
         values (extensions.gen_random_uuid(), $1, $2, 'totp', 'verified', now(), now())`,
        [steward, `casework-parity-${lane}`],
      );
      await client.query("select set_config('request.jwt.claims', $1, true)", [JSON.stringify({
        sub: steward,
        role: "authenticated",
        aal: "aal2",
      })]);
      await client.query("set local role authenticated");
      const pages = await client.query(
        `select page, count(*)::integer rows from (
           select ((row_number() over (order by updated_at desc) - 1) / 50)::integer page
           from public.member_cases where steward_user_id = $1
         ) paged where page in (0, 1) group by page order by page`,
        [steward],
      );
      await client.query("rollback to savepoint authenticated_pages");
      expect(pages.rows).toEqual([{ page: 0, rows: 50 }, { page: 1, rows: 50 }]);
    }
  });

  it("removes and deterministically reapplies one lane without touching the other", async () => {
    await stageSensitiveDemoSeed(seedClient,"presg",runs.presg);
    const presgBefore = await snapshot("presg");
    const uniondemoBefore = await snapshot("uniondemo");
    await client.query(
      "delete from private.demo_seed_function_evidence where lane = 'presg' and run_id = $1 and function_id = 'CR-020'",
      [runs.presg],
    );
    const presgRemoved = await snapshot("presg");
    for (const table of tables) {
      if (table === "casework_audit_events") {
        expect(presgRemoved[table].count, table).toBe(presgBefore[table].count - 120);
      } else {
        expect(presgRemoved[table].count, table).toBe(0);
      }
    }
    expect(await snapshot("uniondemo")).toEqual(uniondemoBefore);

    await client.query(
      `insert into private.demo_seed_function_evidence (lane, run_id, function_id, status, evidence_key)
       select 'presg', $1, function_id, coverage, evidence_key
       from private.demo_seed_function_catalog where function_id = 'CR-020'`,
      [runs.presg],
    );
    const presgAfter = await snapshot("presg");
    for (const table of tables) {
      expect(presgAfter[table].count, table).toBe(presgBefore[table].count);
      expect(presgAfter[table].hash, table).toBe(presgBefore[table].hash);
    }
    expect((await status("presg")).ok).toBe(true);
    expect(await snapshot("uniondemo")).toEqual(uniondemoBefore);
  }, 60_000);
});
